name: Crossbow Frenzy gives Twilight Frenzy 40% movement speed (#2705)
contract: Crossbow Frenzy 705499 reads 'While Twilight Frenzy is active, your movement speed is now increased by $s1%.' In the installed Spell.dbc (server DBC 2026-09-17) it is passive, family 21, effect 0 = SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), misc 12 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, class mask word 1 = 0x100000, BasePoints 39 (DieSides 1, so +40). Twilight Frenzy 805751 carries family 21 and flag word 1 0x100000, and its effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_SPEED (31) with BasePoints -1 (DieSides 1, so 0). Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10219) adds the flat 40 through Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers (Unit.cpp:12149), so effect 1 resolves to 40 and the stock speed aura raises the run speed rate by 40%. The module only suppresses effect 0 of 805751 (AscensionChangelogCompat) and handles Evasive/cleanup (AscensionWitchHunterDefenses.cpp), neither touches effect 1. The buff is applied as fixture state (it lasts 5 s, duration index 28), so every reading is taken within seconds of the fixture.

steps.label: Without the talent effect 1 resolves to 0
Fixture Twilight Frenzy without the talent
No speed change without the talent
Effect 1 resolves to 40 (BasePoints 39 + 1 flat on a base of 0)
Fixture Twilight Frenzy with the talent
